current_events: United States envoys Jared Kushner meets with Hamas leaders to follow up on the U.S.-backed 20-point plan, with Hamas reaffirming their commitment to disarm and demilitarize Gaza
A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shoots down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace. The drone was downed near the city of Galați after entering from Moldova
Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war, Russia–NATO relations

Ukrainian forces launch 822 drones at Russia, including over 600 towards Moscow, killing at least seven people and injuring 39 others. A Wildberries warehouse is also destroyed. Russian officials say it is the largest Ukrainian drone attack launched this year
Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Seven suspected members of the Pakistani Taliban are killed in a intelligence-based joint operation in Kharan District, Balochistan, Pakistan
Two civilians are killed and several homes are damaged by a government airstrike in Thandwe, Rakhine State, Myanmar

The African Union holds a meeting with Sudanese officials in a effort to end the war, the first talks by the AU in the country since the military led by Abdel Fattah al-Burhan seized power in the October 2021 coup
American superhero film Spider-Man: Brand New Day passes $2 billion at the global box office, becoming the second Marvel Studios film to do so after Avengers: Endgame
St. Nicholas' Church from Bączal Dolny is completely destroyed by a fire at the Museum of Folk Architecture, Sanok, Poland
Eleven people are killed after a tourist bus overturned near Petropolis, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
